full_judgment: 4. Mr Md Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on- Record for the petitioners, submits that the learned Judge of the High Court Division instead of discharging the Rule on technical ground ought to have disposed of the Rule on merit since the legality of the judgment of the Court of Additional Sessions Judge affirming the judgment and order of conviction of the petitioners were challenged.
